basis: H012 reproduced a source-reported reverse-plus-three map on LP1/06 but explicitly excluded LP2; this is a new all-applicable-page transfer test, not a repeat of H012.
The map is fixed before observing LP2 output: P=(28-C+3) mod29, or (a,b)=(28,2) over rune ordinals 0..28.
H009 qualified a training-only unigram scorer as a diagnostic; it cannot by itself certify unknown plaintext.
hypothesis: The fixed LP1/06 reverse-plus-three affine map transfers to LP2 rune pages and produces language-like rune outputs more often or more strongly than random invertible affine maps.
mechanistic_basis: Reverse ordinal mapping gives 28-C and the source adds +3, yielding P=(28-C+3) mod29. No key, dictionary, page-specific tuning, skip, reset, delimiter consumption or post-hoc spelling correction is introduced.
falsifiable_predictions: The fixed map can be applied losslessly to all 55 rune-bearing pages in the pinned LP2/0..55 corpus while preserving every non-rune character and page boundary.

At least one applicable page has a fixed-map training-only unigram mean score at maxT-adjusted p<=0.01 against 256 preregistered random invertible affine controls, with higher score meaning more language-like.
The fixed-map output re-encrypts exactly to the original rune sequence on every applicable page, and an independent arithmetic path reproduces all observed scores.
A statistical lead remains only a candidate diagnostic; without an independent plaintext prediction it is not a solved page.
page_universe: LP2/0..55 from attempt1-corpus-v1; rune-bearing LP2/0..49 and LP2/51..55 are applicable, LP2/50 has no rune-domain symbols and is excluded.
scope: All 55 applicable LP2 pages, 12956 rune positions; LP2/50 retained in coverage as inapplicable. No LP1 source plaintext is supplied to the scoring path.
algorithm_version: H013-v1: decode each rune ordinal with (28*C+2) mod29; preserve all non-rune raw characters; score decoded rune indices with H009's frozen training-only unigram weights.
parameter_derivation_policy: The affine coefficients are inherited only as the fixed, source-derived H012 prediction; no LP2 page may choose its own coefficients. Control pairs, seed, score, maxT rule and applicability set are frozen before decoding.
page_and_section_continuity_hypothesis: The substitution is memoryless within each page; no cross-page stream, line reset, separator consumption or page-specific phase is added.

scorer_and_acceptance_version.scorer: Per-page mean of H009's additive-smoothed training-only unigram log weights; no candidate-specific retuning, Latin completion or dictionary.
scorer_and_acceptance_version.controls: For each page, compare the fixed map with 256 unique random invertible affine maps over Z/29Z, excluding (28,2). Standardize each page using observed plus controls and use the maximum control z across pages for maxT p-values.
scorer_and_acceptance_version.lead: A page is a diagnostic lead only when its fixed-map p_adjusted<=0.01 and its rune count is positive. No lead is accepted as plaintext without a separately registered independent prediction.
scorer_and_acceptance_version.negative: If no page meets the lead rule after all controls and validations complete, report negative only for this fixed transfer prediction, score and affine-control null.
scorer_and_acceptance_version.error_or_timeout: Source/data integrity failure, incomplete control budget or failed independent arithmetic is error/timeout/inconclusive, never negative.

frozen_before_candidates: The runner writes frozen.json with source hashes, page order, coefficients, training counts, control seed/pairs and acceptance rule before writing decoded outputs or statistics.

total_budget.origin: Bounded all-applicable-page transfer test for auto-cycle R005; no prior side-chat budget inherited.

controls: 256 fixed-seed unique random invertible affine maps, labeled controls and never promoted to keys.
Page order, rune counts, raw hashes and excluded LP2/50 applicability are checked against the pinned corpus.
Independent direct arithmetic recomputes the fixed transform, score and inverse re-encryption for every rune position.
Decoded raw output preserves delimiters, line markers, whitespace and non-rune literals; no silent normalization is allowed.

randomness.role: Control-map selection only; never a candidate key, seed or plaintext source.

discovery_path: Fixed source-derived affine transfer plus training-only score; no brute-force parameter selection and no hidden answer, dictionary or external network input.
independent_validation_path: A separate direct loop recomputes P=(28-C+3) mod29, the inverse involution, per-page scores and exact rune roundtrips without calling the observed transform helper.
correlated_transform_deduplication: The registered (28,2) map is evaluated once. Random affine pairs are controls, not 256 additional hypotheses; maxT accounts for page multiplicity.
uncovered_parameters: Other affine coefficients, keyed/stream/composite transforms and transpositions
LP2 glyph-image corrections, Latin ambiguity resolution and delimiter semantics
Independent plaintext prediction for any score lead
LP1/14-15 CIRCUMFERENCE and geometry-derived key streams
next_step: If a lead appears, freeze its page and an independent plaintext or structural prediction in a new experiment before interpreting it; otherwise switch to an untested mechanism family rather than retuning affine parameters.
note: A fixed-map score lead is evidence for follow-up only. This batch cannot claim a solved LP2 page from language score alone.
